title: DPDPAVerdict
description: A compliance verdict produced by the Rule Engine for a single Event. IMMUTABILITY CONTRACT: only 'remediation_status' and 'remediation_updated_at' may be mutated after a verdict is written to the Evidence Store. All other fields are immutable and will form part of a hash chain in Phase 6.

verdict_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this verdict. Format: UUID v4. IMMUTABLE.

event_id.description: UUID of the Event that triggered this verdict. Foreign key to event_schema. IMMUTABLE.

rule_id.description: The DPDPA compliance rule that was violated. IMMUTABLE.

severity.description: Severity level assigned by the Rule Engine. IMMUTABLE.

source.description: Source type inherited from the triggering Event. IMMUTABLE.

source_system.description: Source system inherited from the triggering Event. Enables per-system breakdown in audit view. IMMUTABLE.

field.description: The specific PII field name that triggered this verdict (e.g. 'aadhaar', 'pan', 'phone'). IMMUTABLE.

timestamp.description: ISO8601 UTC timestamp of when this verdict was generated. IMMUTABLE.

matched_registry_entry.description: The consent registry entry that was matched (or violated) to produce this verdict. Typed as object stub — Phase 1 will define the registry entry model. IMMUTABLE.

breach_notification_candidate.description: Whether this verdict qualifies as a candidate for DPDPA breach notification to the Data Protection Board of India (72-hour reporting window). Set by Rule Engine. IMMUTABLE.

remediation_status.description: Current human follow-up status. MUTABLE — this and remediation_updated_at are the ONLY fields that may be updated after the verdict is written to the Evidence Store.

remediation_updated_at.description: ISO8601 UTC timestamp of the last remediation_status update. Null until first status change. MUTABLE — only field besides remediation_status that may be updated post-write.
